# Unicorn Engine headers

The public headers of [Unicorn Engine](https://github.com/unicorn-engine/unicorn) 2.x, used only by the
`HPPOA_DIFFTEST` build (`src/difftest.c`), which loads `unicorn.dll` at run time; the DLL is not included.
These headers are licensed under the LGPL 2 (see their file headers and `LICENSES/LGPL-2.1.txt` at the
repository root).
